charter.line: Every boat in the fleet can be hired for your own group: birthdays, hen and stag parties, weddings, family celebrations and theme parties. Drinks, fruit platters and snack packages are available. Prices and times on request.

know: Every cruise leaves from Ayia Napa harbour. Meet at the Black Pearl 30 minutes before departure.
Most cruises run the coast past Love Bridge, the sea caves and Cape Greco to the Blue Lagoon and Konnos Bay. The route can change with the weather and sea.
Cruises run mainly from April to October. Check each cruise for the dates on sale.
Book online up to 2 hours before departure, or message them on WhatsApp for a last-minute seat.
Every rate includes a free date change. Choose the refundable rate if you might need to cancel.
Drinks are on sale on every cruise. Bring swimwear, a towel and sunscreen. No pets on board.
Hotel transfers are available for some cruises at an extra charge. Ask them when you book.
